verdict.rationale: The open-source Whisper CLI accepts multiple audio files in a single command, so it can transcribe several items in one invocation. That is a first-party bulk capability, but a thin one. The API docs only describe single-file uploads capped at 25 MB, and nothing documents batch jobs, parallelism, or large-scale bulk management. Missing for 10: documented batch/bulk API endpoint, glob or directory-level processing, parallel/concurrent bulk execution, bulk result handling and error reporting, independent corroboration of bulk use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: The following command will transcribe speech in audio files, using the `turbo` model: whisper audio.flac audio.mp3 audio.wav --model turbo
Files can be up to 25 MB.
